name: creative-automation
description: Create and monitor creative jobs, batches, approvals, and webhooks on the Creative Automation Platform.

env.CAP_BASE_URL: Base URL of your Creative Automation Platform deployment
env.CAP_TOKEN: Workspace API token (cap_...) from Settings → API Tokens

tools.name: create_job
tools.description: Create a new creative job. AI/ID engines are dispatched to the local bridge agent; Figma/Canva run server-side; 'hybrid' fans out per engine.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get a job by id, including outputs (live-file URLs, PNG/PDF exports, bundles).

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List recent jobs in the workspace, optionally filtered by project.

notes: Webhooks: register an endpoint at Settings → Webhooks to receive job.completed / job.failed events. Payloads are HMAC-SHA256 signed in the x-cap-signature header using the per-webhook secret.
Share links: any output or batch can be exposed as a public read-only URL at /share/<slug> with a configurable expiry.
Token scopes: API tokens now carry a scopes array (jobs:read, jobs:write). Future versions will enforce per-scope restrictions.
